Hospital Course and Therapy
Upon admission to the hospital, a nasogastric tube with suction was placed and his nausea and 
vomiting resolved. He was placed on NPO (nothing to eat or drink) restrictions. His nasogastric 
tube drained 800 to 1200 mL of feculent fluid the first day. At the same time, he was rehydrated
